Forgetting the charge ratio gives $r=60\,\mathrm{cm}$, $T=8\,\mu\mathrm{s}$ (option 1); assuming the period is proportional to speed gives $12\,\mu\mathrm{s}$ (option 3); ignoring both mass and charge ratios and using only the speed ratio gives $r=15\,\mathrm{cm}$ (option 4).
